DHORI PE NIMBU | AASHISH YADAV & SHWETA SARGAM | NEW BHOJPURI SONG
Taiyar ho jaie ekdam naya aur dhamakedar bhojpuri gana “DHORI PE NIMBU” ke sath!
Is gane men Aashish Yadav & Shweta Sargam ki shandar aavaz, Chintu Raja ke majedar bol aur Priyanshu Singh ka damdar sangit sunne ko milega. shandar vidiyo aur behatrin dans parphormens is gane ko aur bhi khas banate hain.
